entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can use your surroundings to accelerate your movement, and your enemy’s presence pushes you further.

Prerequisite(s): Favored enemy class feature, favored terrain class feature.

Benefit(s): While you’re in any of your favored terrain types, you gain a 5-foot bonus to your movement speed. This bonus increases to 10 feet if a creature of the same type as one of your favored enemies is visible and within the same terrain type.
